domains.tag: Gouvernement/Ministère des Affaires municipales et de l'Habitation

alerts.name: quality
alerts.title: quality
alerts.query:
SELECT table_name, measure, criticality, round(actual, 2) AS actual, unit, operator, threshold,
  threshold_high, checked_at, CASE WHEN passed THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS exceeded
FROM (
SELECT table_name, coalesce(check_name, metric) AS measure, criticality, metric, actual, unit,
  operator, threshold, threshold_high, passed, checked_at, run_id
FROM (
  SELECT *, max(checked_at) OVER (PARTITION BY summary_table, table_name) AS latest_checked_at
  FROM (
  SELECT *, '${environment}.donnees_qc_repertoire_municipalites._quality_summary' AS summary_table FROM `${environment}`.`donnees_qc_repertoire_municipalites`.`_quality_summary`
  WHERE data_product = 'donnees_qc.repertoire_municipalites' AND table_name IN ('arrondissement', 'conseiller_arrondissement', 'conseiller_municipal', 'municipalite', 'organisme_supramunicipal', 'ressource')
  ) AS summary
) AS runs
WHERE checked_at = latest_checked_at AND passed IS NOT NULL
) AS thresholds
ORDER BY exceeded DESC, table_name, measure

alerts.name: latency
alerts.title: latency
alerts.query:
SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT 'arrondissement' AS table_name, '2 days' AS latency, updated_at,
    CASE WHEN updated_at >= current_timestamp() - INTERVAL '2' DAY THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS exceeded
  FROM (SELECT max(last_altered) AS updated_at FROM `${environment}`.`information_schema`.`tables` WHERE table_schema = 'donnees_qc_repertoire_municipalites' AND table_name = 'arrondissement') AS t
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'conseiller_arrondissement' AS table_name, '2 days' AS latency, updated_at,
    CASE WHEN updated_at >= current_timestamp() - INTERVAL '2' DAY THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS exceeded
  FROM (SELECT max(last_altered) AS updated_at FROM `${environment}`.`information_schema`.`tables` WHERE table_schema = 'donnees_qc_repertoire_municipalites' AND table_name = 'conseiller_arrondissement') AS t
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'conseiller_municipal' AS table_name, '2 days' AS latency, updated_at,
    CASE WHEN updated_at >= current_timestamp() - INTERVAL '2' DAY THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS exceeded
  FROM (SELECT max(last_altered) AS updated_at FROM `${environment}`.`information_schema`.`tables` WHERE table_schema = 'donnees_qc_repertoire_municipalites' AND table_name = 'conseiller_municipal') AS t
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'municipalite' AS table_name, '2 days' AS latency, updated_at,
    CASE WHEN updated_at >= current_timestamp() - INTERVAL '2' DAY THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS exceeded
  FROM (SELECT max(last_altered) AS updated_at FROM `${environment}`.`information_schema`.`tables` WHERE table_schema = 'donnees_qc_repertoire_municipalites' AND table_name = 'municipalite') AS t
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'organisme_supramunicipal' AS table_name, '2 days' AS latency, updated_at,
    CASE WHEN updated_at >= current_timestamp() - INTERVAL '2' DAY THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS exceeded
  FROM (SELECT max(last_altered) AS updated_at FROM `${environment}`.`information_schema`.`tables` WHERE table_schema = 'donnees_qc_repertoire_municipalites' AND table_name = 'organisme_supramunicipal') AS t
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'ressource' AS table_name, '2 days' AS latency, updated_at,
    CASE WHEN updated_at >= current_timestamp() - INTERVAL '2' DAY THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS exceeded
  FROM (SELECT max(last_altered) AS updated_at FROM `${environment}`.`information_schema`.`tables` WHERE table_schema = 'donnees_qc_repertoire_municipalites' AND table_name = 'ressource') AS t
) AS freshness
ORDER BY table_name
